forbidden_transitions.reason: Successor identity must be an explicit operator decision with hypothesis_id and mechanism definition.
GO alone is never executable without a concrete target (successor identity, closeout decision, or enumerated lane action).
OPEN_BACKLOG requires non-empty open or preregistered inventory.
Closed lanes may reopen only via explicit reopen decision plus new hypothesis identity; implicit successors are forbidden.
Evaluation evidence, metrics, run-slot claims, and result digests are immutable after seal.
Preregistration economic contracts and digests are immutable after seal.
Terminal PASS/FAIL never auto-closes a lane; closeout requires an explicit operator closeout decision.
Empty inventory after terminal does not imply awaiting successor without an explicit waiting declaration.

governance_note: Shared conceptual lifecycle grammar for research lanes after the active hypothesis becomes terminal and inventories may be empty. Does not migrate Entry-Eligibility or Exit-Efficiency backlog SSOTs in this slice.

immutability_policy.mutable_surface_rule: Only the live lane backlog SSOT (and explicitly marked live decision records) may change after execution; historical authority/ratification/evidence objects remain sealed snapshots and must not be rewritten to mirror live next-step changes.

invalid_states.description: Operator GO present without concrete target identity (successor hypothesis_id, closeout decision id, or enumerated action target).
Successor hypothesis created without explicit operator decision naming hypothesis_id and mechanism.
status=OPEN_BACKLOG while open and preregistered inventories are empty and no explicit awaiting/closed decision is recorded.
status=LANE_CLOSED_NO_FURTHER_RESEARCH while an implicit or unnamed successor is assumed.
Any rewrite of sealed evaluation evidence, metrics, run-slot claims, or result digests.
status=AWAITING_EXPLICIT_SUCCESSOR_HYPOTHESIS without an explicit operator waiting decision record.
status=LANE_CLOSED_NO_FURTHER_RESEARCH without an explicit operator closeout decision record.

migration_deferred.entry_eligibility_impact: Currently status=OPEN_BACKLOG with empty open_candidates and empty preregistered_hypotheses; under this contract that combination is invalid (OPEN_LANE_EMPTY_INVENTORY_WITHOUT_WAITING_SEMANTICS). Cross-lane token CLOSED_NO_OPEN_CANDIDATES is not a canonical lane status. Migration requires a separate operator-authorized slice.
migration_deferred.exit_efficiency_impact: Currently status=OPEN_BACKLOG with empty open_unpreregistered_candidates and empty preregistered_hypotheses after V8 TERMINAL_PASS; under this contract that combination is invalid. Migration to AWAITING_EXPLICIT_SUCCESSOR_HYPOTHESIS or LANE_CLOSED_NO_FURTHER_RESEARCH requires a separate operator-authorized slice; historical V8 artifacts must remain immutable.

ownership.closeout_and_reopen_decisions: Explicit operator decision recorded on the lane backlog SSOT; vocabulary/validity owned by this shared lifecycle contract.
ownership.lane_status: Lane-specific backlog SSOT owns the current status value; this shared contract owns the canonical status vocabulary, predicates, and transition legality.
ownership.post_terminal_transition: This shared contract owns legal post-terminal transitions; the lane backlog SSOT records the applied transition under operator authorization.
ownership.successor_identity: Explicit operator CREATE_SUCCESSOR_HYPOTHESIS decision plus new preregistration artifact; never auto-created by evaluation closeout.

post_terminal_transitions.note: PASS and FAIL share the empty-inventory operator-decision requirement. Lane-specific policies may further restrict which enumerated decisions are admissible, but may not invent auto-successor, auto-close, or executable GO without target.

AWAITING_EXPLICIT_SUCCESSOR_HYPOTHESIS.semantics: Lane inventories are empty and all existing hypotheses are terminal; the operator has explicitly declared that the lane awaits a successor hypothesis. Waiting is named; no successor identity exists yet; GO alone is not executable.

LANE_CLOSED_NO_FURTHER_RESEARCH.semantics: Lane intentionally closed with no further research action. Reopening requires an explicit reopen decision and a new hypothesis identity; closed lanes must not carry an implicit successor.

OPEN_BACKLOG.semantics: Backlog actively open with candidates: at least one open_unpreregistered candidate and/or at least one preregistered hypothesis exists. OPEN_BACKLOG is invalid when both inventories are empty.

POST_TERMINAL_OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED.semantics: Active hypothesis is terminal and both open and preregistered inventories are empty, but the operator has not yet recorded an explicit awaiting, closeout, or successor-creation decision. This state exists so empty-inventory openness is never implied.

totality_invariant.definition: Every reachable canonical lane state must have exactly one of: (1) a deterministic canonical next transition, (2) an explicitly enumerated operator decision set, or (3) a terminal closed state.
